notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, Animal Trainers! 🐾[/b][/h3]

We’re thrilled to announce the latest update for Animal Trainer Simulator, featuring many important changes and improvements to make your gameplay experience even better! 🎉

[h3][b]Key Updates:[/b][/h3]
Enhanced Graphics and Optimization 🌟 – we’ve refreshed the game’s visuals and improved its performance to provide a smoother and more realistic experience! 🎮✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/d12dd645e1c313b25b3f513dd8c20b486739d749.png[/img][i]Before[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f095b9c5965bf7e9cd31c4f3497c42c5c0d3a66d.png[/img][i]After[/i]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/a4c350780414e4482c3a98545a9bc042d2f652af.png[/img][i]Before[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/75b2256e90c7f1abbbbaddc01664b35a19117021.png[/img][i]After[/i]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/93c7610a97ed8e7ee7522a77b1dde2d19bab8950.png[/img][i]Before[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/47c5f9b3aee38e0d7de1861e0ac67ac0b45ef981.png[/img][i]After[/i]



[h3][b]
Patch Notes:[/b][/h3]
🐶 Fixed an issue where a dog's satisfaction wouldn’t increase during playtime.
💧 Fixed collision issues with water in certain areas.
📌 Added the ability to pin required training tasks for each animal.
📧 Improved the email app – added more order details and information.
🐕 Added unique icons for each pet breed.
🐾 Fixed a bug causing dogs to disappear during the attack mini-game (affected all breeds).
🍲 Resolved an issue in the tutorial where the dog wouldn’t eat or drink on its own after loading the game.
🎛️ Improved game loading function from the menu.
🐴 Fixed the trailer floor for horses.
🔄 Corrected horse rotation when entering the trailer.
🛒 Added a shopping cart function in the store, allowing players to add and remove items before purchase.
🏷️ Updated product details in the store – added quantity information and improved price display.
🌍 Corrected translations in the email app and store.
Improved Optimization 🚀 – the game now runs faster and smoother than ever.
Enhanced Visuals 🎨 – Animal Trainer Simulator now looks even better!
🛑 Blocked the ability to enter water.
🛠️ Other minor improvements and fixes.
🐴It is now possible to wash the horse
📉The game's disk space usage has been reduced



Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback, which help us continually improve the game! Jump back in to explore all the new features, and let us know what you think. 🌟🐾

[b]See you in the game!
The Animal Trainer Simulator Team 🐾[/b]

notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Trainers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Welcome back to the new devlog! This is one of the last devlogs before the release of the full version of Animal Trainer Simulator. 🐶 Today, we’d like to tell you a bit about some changes and features introduced to the game after listening to [b]your requests[/b]. 

First of all, many of you were concerned with leaving your animals in the car when you left the vehicle for a moment- that’s why [b]we’ll introduce information about the air conditioning switched on[/b] when you leave the car. 💨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/9ecee087c0a884d081824c49cd41bbb0e36dcaa1.png[/img]
Another frequently mentioned topic was the fact you’ve found the quality of some translations lacking. We agree and the full version will receive significant improvements in this area as well! 👍

You’ve also pointed out that some areas are empty, that’s why we’ve decided to address this issue with three different improvements:

[list]1. We’ve added more decoratives throughout the entire map to make the are feel more filled 🌳

2. We’ve added more people in areas near both your and your clients’ houses to make them more lively 🏃

3. Last but not least we’ve added some cute static dogs sitting next to their owners while they’re interacting with other people. 🐕[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/16d6e4899e99b62a1eab94adfa13a8a563509eaf.png[/img]
There are more things to be added in the full version but we’ll leave them for you to discover! We hope you’ve enjoyed this short devlog. If you still haven’t done so, we encourage you to try the Prologue version of our game, it’s free to play! ❤️‍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/
[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/25164ca9ba6e5cb65460a9a63ca7599efe9b0469.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Animal Trainer Simulator Team

notes.title: Enviroment
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

Before we dig into today’s devlog we’d like to once again [b]thank you all for taking part in the Playtest[/b]! We’re grateful for all the feedback you’ve provided us with and now we understand more in which direction you’d like the game to go! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f3d5128463c9b4241202833a414d85b086df295a.png[/img]
With that being said, let’s move on to the actual devlog because the dev team worked really hard on the in-game lighting! ☀️ [b]We’ve managed to achieve lighting that gives a great natural vibe![/b]

On top of that, many hidden paths (which you can find by exploring the surrounding terrains on the horse you can adopt) have been given some extra love. Our goal is to give you an exciting and interesting area to explore. ⛰️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/77cf706a390d064881b426039eb0bc36353851e9.png[/img]
There are also [b]collectibles[/b]! 🤩 Keep in mind they’ll not be easy to find. We don’t want to share too much about them so you can have fun figuring this out by yourself but we’re wondering if you have any ideas? Let us know in the comments! 🔥

On top of that, [b]all locations have received additional details [/b]and more!

Additionally, throughout the entire playtest and Steam Next Fest you’ve been giving us a lot of suggestions, that’s why we’re introducing several changes to the game which will hopefully meet your expectations towards the gameplay! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/9c89efc2ffeae2441bfd212c0f105eba09c89b84.png[/img]
[h3]One of the already implemented changes is the possibility for the owners of the animals to deliver their pupils by themselves without making us pick them up from their homes! You’ve been frequently mentioning that driving for each and every animal may be annoying and that’s why we decided to bring the animals to the players! ❤️[/h3]

We’ll make sure to keep you updated on the implemented changes so [b]make sure to add our game to your wishlists on Steam to not miss on any information[/b]! We’d also like to invite you to [b]join our discord community[/b] where you can meet other people interested in our game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/ 
[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/25164ca9ba6e5cb65460a9a63ca7599efe9b0469.png[/img][/url] 

See you soon,
Animal Trainer Simulator Team

notes.title: Animal breeds
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Animal Traners! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re happy to have you back with us in another devlog from Animal Trainer Simulator! 🐶 For the last month we’ve been working really hard to introduce diversity to the models of horses and dogs which will be available in the game. 👏[/h3]

We wanted their looks and characteristics not only to be as diverse as possible but also for those different characteristics to have an actual impact on the gameplay! 📝

[b]Finally, our work brought some quality results and the breeds and races of animals will matter if you want to train them. 🤩[/b] Some animal races because of their inborn attitude are more or less prone to learning new commands or tricks. On top of that, the race will also have an impact on the time you need to spend with an animal for it to achieve the set training goals ⏱️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/04a72863d0117da84f315b54a199a2652d9f3448.png[/img]


[h3][b]There will be many dog races, such as:[/b][/h3]

🐾 Akita Inu
🐾 Border Collie
🐾 Dalmatian
🐾 Doberman
🐾 Golden Retriever
🐾 Husky
🐾 Labrador
🐾 German Shepherd
🐾 Pitbull

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f8b6fb2fde488d07e7ff72be44e751322dfc6d5c.png[/img]


[h3]And because of the extremely different features of character those breeds display we could sort them into two general categories: [/h3]

[b]Easier to train ✅[/b]
Which are the Border Collie Golden Retriever Labrador, German Shepherd

[b]Harder to train 🤏[/b]
Akita Inu, Dalmatian, Husky, Pitbull

[b]Dobermans on the other hand, on top of their abilities are great learners when it comes to attack and defense training with the use of training dummies because of their strong protective instinct and inborn courage! 💝[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/cae3831f1168a7997b7e114b9a2f819ae8f2d53d.png[/img]


[h3][b]You’ll be able to train the dogs in the following activities/commands 🧐:[/b][/h3]

-Down
-Speak
-Shake
-Stand on two paws
-Training Dummy attack
-Ramp Walking
-Ring Jumping
-Slalom

[b]Some of your animals will be more prone to learn certain commands/skills where others will struggle ☝️[/b]


[h3]Once again, being a good animal trainer is a very complicated subject and requires a lot of knowledge about each particular animal you’re dealing with.[/h3]


Let us know in the comments what you think about this aspect of our game ❗ We can’t wait to hear your opinions and suggestions! As always, we’d love to invite you to join our discord community and to add our game to your wishlists on Steam! 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/25164ca9ba6e5cb65460a9a63ca7599efe9b0469.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/ 

[b]See you soon,
Animal Trainer Simulator Team
[/b]

notes.title: House
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello trainers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re happy to have you back again in another devlog❣️ As you’re well aware, just staying at work is not healthy. That’s why in Animal Trainer Simulator you can go to the town hall and buy yourself a brand new home with different coloristics and furniture.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/93bddcd2d2ca8aef0cf2a57fabf7e7edfdc3f71a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/2b5ed13f3a5f8e151c515cb9a86a227ddb8823a5.png[/img]
[b]Although you can only buy one home, you’re free to change it’s interior any way you’d like at any point throughout your gameplay. 🖌️ Don’t forget it does come with the cost but as a wealthy trainer you’ll be able to afford it easily. 🙂[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/3fd5ff423e01e78103d9b92cdd3dc6c819efbfbb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/06d7335d0a23546881694f06eff4726cab1876b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/0d57303a686525c9679c72137645ec415480241b.png[/img]
At home you’ll be able to satisfy the most basic needs your character will have such as thirst, hunger, fatigue etc. Without meeting those needs you’ll not be able to train or the training will be suboptimal, to say the least. 📝 It doesn’t mean it’ll be a big obstacle, these are all simple, unrequiring activities and a great way to visit your own pet once in a while. 🐶 After all, as we’ve already mentioned before you can adopt a cute animal from the animal shelter to accompany you in your training journey. 🤩

[h3]We’re wondering, what other elements would you like to have at your home? Let us know in the comments! 👍[/h3]

As always, we’re happy to have you read the devlog and we’d like to invite you to join our discord 👇 and add the game to your wishlist on Steam!

[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/25164ca9ba6e5cb65460a9a63ca7599efe9b0469.png[/img][/url] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/ 

See you soon,
Animal Trainer Simulator Team

notes.title: Cars
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Trainers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]As you most certainly know, our game’s main objective is to train your clients’ animals. 🐕 To deliver the highest quality of your service you’ll also have to be ready to pick them up at home and once you finish the training- driving them back. 🐴[/h3]

[h2]For that purpose players will own a car… actually not just one car.[/h2] 🚙

[h3]We’ve added [b]“Car DealerShop”[/b] to the game. It's a place which was created to meet all of your automotive expectations and needs. 🚚 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/d80f5fd4216f4cc75ea26fe7443aef0314384a82.png[/img]
[h3]Because of the vast difference in sizes of the transported animal e.g. Horses and dogs you’ll need something bigger than a car. Therefore, we’ve introduced pickups to the game! 👍[/h3]

Players will be able to do their shopping there using the cash earned through their work! 💰 They’ll be different from each other in the following aspects:

[b]- looks,
- engine power,
- capacity of the storage trunk,
- number of seats required to transport pets.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/25dcfda30cb6d8ef6144644fa746cbf9d96f204c.png[/img]
[h3]On top of that, you’ll also be able to buy all kinds of frailers which will help you during horse or even horses transportation. (depending on a model) 🤩[/h3]

At this point you may have wondered… Where will I keep all those vehicles I buy? Don’t worry! You’ll be able to store all of them in your private bottomless garage which basically means, you can have as many cars as you’d like!  🙂 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/c267ab8344c5bffd3e09b67d98dd6be80d122b22.png[/img]
You’ll be able to choose the car you’ll drive through the players' garage menu situated nearby the house! 😀 With all of that said, pick your ride and enjoy your time driving through the picturesque landscapes of Animal Trainer Simulator! ⛰️

If you enjoy the development process of our game, [b]consider joining our discord community 👇 and adding our game to your wishlists[/b] 👇.

[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/ 

See you soon,
Animal Trainer Team

notes.title: Personal Pets!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Trainers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]We’re back with another update from our animal training facility! 🤩 Today we’d like introduce you to [b]something you’ve frequently asked for[/b]. Animals are undoubtedly the main stars of our production and helping them and their owners is your task. But why should you not be able to become an owner yourself...[/h3]

[h2]Therefore, we are happy to announce players will now be able to have their own animals! 👍[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/cb084f1f3b1238451601a989329df88ab5442973.png[/img]
[h3]Currently, players have a possibility to take care of a dog and a horse.[/h3]

[b]To adopt a pupil you’ll have to visit an Animal Shelter [/b]😜 where different animals will await you. After choosing the most charming one, you’ll have to [b]name it, take care of it and train it if you’d like to teach it some skills.[/b] 🐕 It’s up to you whether your personal pupil will undergo the training. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f5492127645e74eb016f783266fd7565b6417f1f.png[/img]
Your pupils, unlike those you’re taking care of at work, will be able to spend time with you at home, will follow you and will be allowed to join you during trips❣️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f5492127645e74eb016f783266fd7565b6417f1f.png[/img]
You’ll be able to use your personal horse companion to venture to the city or have a little ride around the facility. 👏

[h3][b]Keep in mind animals are not only great companions but also responsibilities! Remember to keep it well-fed, entertained, groomed and all the other activities needed to ensure your pupils have a wonderful life! [/b][/h3]

[b]Join our discord 👇[/b] and let us know what other interactions would you like to have with your pupils! Don’t forget to [b]add our game to your wishlist [/b]👇 to not miss on any further update!

[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Horse riding
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Trainers! 🐶[/b][/h1]

	[h3]The work never stops and this time, we are happy to show you a little insight into what we were working on recently. 🤩 As all of you know, our game is [b]all about animals[/b] and to make them even more integral part of the experience we present to you the [b]horse riding[/b]. 🏇[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/30f61a3f1886b30170cc08d065de47d035e62c9c.png[/img]

	[b]Admire the views[/b],[b] build good relationships[/b] 💝 [b]with your horses[/b] and make you both happier by [b]riding together[/b]. That’s not all! Your rides can be typically recreational or lead to a specific destination. 
Whether you go to the city hall 🏛️, need to visit a vet 🏥 or just feel like having a little jaunt 🗺️now you can do it all while [b]riding your favorite mount[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/4e810dd64b02cb50484b9bd97bdbb8f1cf72ddf8.png[/img]

	[h3]Keep in mind we’re all animal lovers ❤️ and while horses are without a doubt strong and reliable 💪, they also deserve some free time to rest 😴. That’s why you should always consider using your car to go shopping. 🚗[/h3]

	At the very beginning you’ll be given a [b]standard pick-up[/b] but don’t hesitate to change it to a [b]more suitable model.[/b] 💲 🚙 💰 It’s always good to invest in better equipment as a [b]responsible owner[/b].

[h2]Question for players:
What are the traffic rules for horseback riders in the city? The standard one? Special ones?  Let us know in the comments below this post!
[/h2]

	Animals are undoubtedly the most crucial part of our production 😸and we will keep doing our best to make them an even bigger part of the experience. To make sure you don’t miss on further updates and be able to give us your opinions and ideas [b]add our game to your wishlist[/b] and click the link below to [b]join our discord community[/b] and meet other animal lovers. 👇 We are still in the early stage of production, so every suggestion or idea from you is important to us. 😍

[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/

See you soon,
Animal Trainer Team

notes.title: Types of buildings🏨in the game
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Animal Trainers! [/b]🏇[/h1]

We have a new [b]devlog[/b] for you🤗

[h1][b]Buildings[/b]🏫[/h1]
[b]Town hall[/b] offers the ability to extend the territory owned, purchase of a new home and swapping it for a new/different one💫
With the addition of [b]buildings[/b] comes the option to [b]interact[/b] with them by going inside them and [b]buying[/b] necessary [b]equipment[/b]🍱
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/98ca229d527518a6f39e159576bf7a83d074f054.png[/img]

and then driving it back home🏠
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/cac7956694ab618d0a1e27f4695c8999bd42a504.png[/img]

How about riding around town on a [b]horse[/b] 😱
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/30f61a3f1886b30170cc08d065de47d035e62c9c.png[/img]
You will also be able to take your sick animal to a vet and bring them back (that one, not on a [b]horse[/b])❌🐎

Also if we accept an [b]animal[/b] for [b]training[/b] we will have to drive to get him, and then drive him back when the [b]training[/b] is done🚗
[h1][b]Environment[/b]🌳[/h1]
We are gradually improving the [b]environment[/b] so it looks better and better🧐

I mean, just look at the [b]clouds[/b]😮
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/4e810dd64b02cb50484b9bd97bdbb8f1cf72ddf8.png[/img]

[h1][b]Let us know what you think[/b]💭[/h1] 
Whether it's about the [b]clouds[/b] or if you have any thoughts on the go to the shop and buy things feature let us know in [b]Discord[/b] linked below!

[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2199860/Animal_Trainer_Simulator/

Till next time!
The [b]Animal Trainer[/b] Team
